changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cmr_dict ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '类型ID*1000+序号', type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '类型 alias', alias VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '项值', label VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '显示名', sort INT DEFAULT 0, enabled TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, remark VARCHAR(256), create_id BIGINT, create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F', UNIQUE KEY uk_type_alias (type, alias) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 字典';
